title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Logarithms
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: If $x$ and $y$ are positive real numbers such that $\log_x(x^2 + 12) = 4$ and $3\log_y x = 1$, then $x+y$ equals
questions.explain:
From the first equation: $\log_x(x^2+12) = 4 \implies x^4 = x^2 + 12$. Let $k = x^2$, then $k^2 - k - 12 = 0 \implies (k-4)(k+3) = 0$. Since $x$ is a real number, $x^2 = 4 \implies x = 2$ (as $x > 0$). 
From the second equation: $3\log_y x = 1 \implies \log_y 2 = 1/3 \implies y^{1/3} = 2 \implies y = 8$. 
Thus, $x + y = 2 + 8 = 10$.
